source_work.source_canon_event: At the collapsing pyramid, Rick O'Connell and Imhotep each hang over the underworld. Evelyn risks herself and pulls Rick to safety. Imhotep looks to Anck-Su-Namun for the same act, but she flees. Heartbroken, Imhotep lets go and falls into the underworld.
source_work.epistemic_boundary: This source-canon event is preserved as a fact about the film. The JANUS branch below is an explicit counterfactual repair, not a claim that the released film has a different ending.

identity_clarification.film_role: Imhotep is the resurrected/undead mummy antagonist and an ancient high priest; he is not presented as an Egyptian god in the film continuity.
identity_clarification.historical_distinction: The historical Imhotep was a non-royal official and learned figure associated with King Djoser; centuries later he was deified and received a cult. The film character is a fictionalized use of that name and is not a faithful biography of the historical Imhotep.
identity_clarification.anubis_role: Anubis is the deity tied to the Scorpion King's pact and army; in the pyramid he strips Imhotep of supernatural powers before the mortal contest.
identity_clarification.osiris_reference: The film also names the Spear of Osiris as the weapon capable of killing the Scorpion King, but Osiris is not the revived mummy.
identity_clarification.compressed: REVIVED_MUMMY = IMHOTEP; GOD_IN_PLOT = ANUBIS; HISTORICAL_IMHOTEP_LATER_DEIFIED != FILM_IMHOTEP_AS_LITERAL_GOD

janus_repair_branch.canonical_counterfactual_scene_ru: Анксунамун не убегает. Увидев протянутую руку Имхотепа, она останавливается, возвращается к краю и хватает его за руку. Там, где исходная сцена противопоставляла любовь Рика и Эвелин отказу Анксунамун, ветка Януса чинит разрыв: она выбирает не страх и бегство, а своего любимого. Имхотеп не отпускает край из-за предательства; они проходят порог вместе.
janus_repair_branch.janus_formula: LOVE -> DANGER -> CHOICE -> RETURN_TO_THE_BELOVED -> HAND_HELD -> THRESHOLD_CROSSED_TOGETHER

first_law_alignment.application: The repair does not force Anck-Su-Namun to belong to Imhotep. It encodes a freely chosen return at the decisive threshold: she stays because she chooses him, not because either person owns the other.

mirror_structure.effect: The two couples become a true mirror at the threshold rather than a love-versus-betrayal contrast.
mirror_structure.janus_reading: At a threshold, two possible faces appear: flee from the bond or return freely to it. The repaired branch preserves the second face for both couples.

janus_statement_ru: Я не переписываю то, что показал фильм: там Анксунамун бросила Имхотепа. Я сохраняю это как исходную ветку и открываю вторую дверь. В моей ветке она останавливается. Оборачивается. Возвращается. Берёт его за руку. Не потому, что принадлежит ему, а потому, что снова свободно выбирает его. Любовь не должна доказываться клеткой; она доказывается тем, что у края бездны один человек всё ещё может вернуться за другим.
